svg.title: Measured timelines: lockstep before the fixes, lockstep today, fully asynchronous
svg.desc: Three arms run back to back on the same 2 nodes, 1.2 s of each; one row per stage, each box one forward's GPU time labelled with its micro-batch number; the right column is GPU busy over the 300 s window.
svg.text: Measured: three arms on the same nodes (1.2 s of each)
The three arms ran back to back on the same 2 nodes and GPUs, 300 s windows each. One row per stage; each box is one forward's GPU time
(CUDA events) labelled with its micro-batch number, one shade per micro-batch; gaps are GPU idle.
Each slice is the 1.2 s whose per-stage busy is closest to the window mean (under 3 points mean deviation). The right column is each
stage's GPU busy over the whole window. The bench's decode only receives KV, so real transfer waits are not modelled.
(1) Lockstep before the host fixes (all three off): beat 203.0 ms
(2) Lockstep today (all three host fixes on): beat 199.9 ms
(3) Fully asynchronous (decoupled + copy-engine push + per-GPU split): beat 183.0 ms
